sourceMaterials: User-supplied presentations in materials; original files unchanged.

validation.visualReview: Desktop screenshots for four project pages; 320 CSS pixel layouts checked.
validation.media: New MP4 files decoded successfully, with no audio streams; complete HTML and WebVTT descriptions.

contentReview: Airborne transport and surface-mediated room risk are described as distinct modeling examples.
Archived screenshots are not presented as a live risk calculation tool.
Surgical positioning prototypes and proposed cleaning concepts are identified separately.
Microbial community composition is not represented as an infection score; source sample sets are not conflated.
Coastal page explicitly presents design and assembly concepts; no assembly trials or field performance are claimed.
Original research authors and publication titles are retained; team papers remain outside the personal publication list.
No UF branding or affiliation introductions added to project pages.
limitations: Automated checks do not certify complete ADA/WCAG compliance.
Screen-reader usability across assistive technologies has not been fully evaluated.
External PDFs and publisher pages are not certified for accessibility.
Original numerical datasets and interactive 3D models were not supplied; source figures are retained with text descriptions.
GitHub Pages controls HTTP response headers; a restrictive CSP is supplied in generated HTML.
